headline: Japan puts AI robots into the workplace to offset labor shortages
summary: Japan is intensifying the use of AI robots across hospitals, factories, logistics and other fields as labour shortages become more serious, according to the report.
why: Japan faces a shrinking workforce, so automation and robotics adoption affects productivity trends and the outlook for robotics and industrial technology companies.
